meta.name: Chad Powers
meta.description:
Eight years after an unforgivable mistake nukes his promising college football career, hotshot quarterback Russ Holliday tries to resurrect his dreams by disguising himself as Chad Powers - a talented oddball who walks on to the struggling South Georgia Catfish.

Not complete. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 not on server

videos.title: 1ST QUARTER
videos.overview: Years after bad boy QB Russ Holliday nuked his college football career, he attempts to walk on to the struggling South Georgia Catfish program disguised as a young man named Chad Powers.

videos.title: 2ND QUARTER
videos.overview: Chad struggles to compete for the starting QB job, then struggles even more maintaining his new identity at Coach Hudson's lake house barbecue.

videos.title: 3RD QUARTER
videos.overview: It's the second half of the season opener against Ole Miss and the Catfish are losing. Stuck on the sidelines together, Chad and Ricky team up and try to save the day.

videos.title: 4TH QUARTER
videos.overview: The night before an away game in Knoxville, Russ and Danny must sneak out of the team hotel and go on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

videos.title: 5TH QUARTER
videos.overview: The Catfish are 5-0, Chad Powers is a superstar, and ESPN wants to feature him on College Gameday. What could go wrong?

videos.title: 6TH QUARTER
videos.overview: On the eve of the biggest game of the season, the truth about Chad Powers threatens to emerge.
